details.title: Software Development and Services Agreement
details.governing_law: laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the applicable federal laws of the United Arab Emirates
details.courts_or_seat: courts of the Emirate of Dubai (onshore Dubai Courts)

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the applicable federal laws of the United Arab Emirates.

details.parties_quote:
1.1 TravelHub FZ-LLC, a free zone limited liability company licensed by the Dubai Development Authority under licence no. 104772, with its office at Office 1408, Building 3, Dubai Internet City, P.O. Box 502211, Dubai, United Arab Emirates ("TravelHub" or "Customer"); and

1.2 AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation, with its principal office at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, NJ 08540, USA ("AtliQ" or "Developer").

payment_source.quote: TravelHub shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date by wire transfer to the bank account specified on the invoice.

details.services_summary: Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-driven features including an Itinerary Personalization Engine and Partner Hotel Ranking Module for the TravelHub App.

liability_cap.basis: total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim
liability_cap.quote: Each Party's total liability arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breach of confidentiality or wilful misconduct.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party directly involved in the Services during the term and for 12 months thereafter.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: solicit for employment any employee of the other Party directly involved in the Services
restrictive_covenants.quote: During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party directly involved in the Services.

findings.title: US entity under non-US law (laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the applicable federal laws of the United Arab Emirates)
findings.why: AtliQ Inc has no presence outside the US; disputes would be fought abroad.
findings.comparison: Principle: US law for AtliQ Inc. Brightwater signed this way and it cost $23k.
findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Emirate of Dubai and the applicable federal laws of the United Arab Emirates.

findings.title: AtliQ Inc named for a non-US client (United Arab Emirates)
findings.why: AtliQ Inc serves US clients only; the entity decides tax, invoicing and bank account.
findings.comparison: Entity sheet: clients outside the US contract with AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd.
findings.quote:
1.1 TravelHub FZ-LLC, a free zone limited liability company licensed by the Dubai Development Authority under licence no. 104772, with its office at Office 1408, Building 3, Dubai Internet City, P.O. Box 502211, Dubai, United Arab Emirates ("TravelHub" or "Customer"); and

1.2 AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation, with its principal office at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, NJ 08540, USA ("AtliQ" or "Developer").

findings.title: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
findings.why: TravelHub is a hospitality business in UAE/Saudi Arabia. Services involve AI-driven features, directly conflicting with the non-compete for Al Noor Hospitality Group.
findings.comparison: Do not take analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hotel groups in the GCC until about September 2029 without Al Noor's written consent.
findings.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 12.4 lets Al Noor waive it per engagement by written consent. Waiver letter of 10 Feb 2026 allows only the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW; not follow-on SOWs, other hotels or Affiliates.

findings.title: Liability cap excludes confidentiality and wilful misconduct
findings.why: Removing caps for confidentiality or misconduct creates uncapped liability exposure for AtliQ, which is a significant financial risk.
findings.comparison: AtliQ prefers a hard 1x cap on all liability; this clause introduces exceptions that could lead to unlimited exposure.
findings.quote: Each Party's total liability arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breach of confidentiality or wilful misconduct.

findings.title: Unilateral IP indemnity
findings.why: This is a one-sided indemnity. It does not exclude claims arising from TravelHub's modifications or instructions.
findings.comparison: AtliQ's principles require mutual indemnity; this clause is unilateral.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall defend and indemnify TravelHub against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe any intellectual property right.

findings.title: Performance-based acceptance criteria
findings.why: These are technical performance guarantees. Failure to meet these could lead to non-payment or breach of contract, as they are tied to acceptance.
findings.comparison: AtliQ typically avoids performance guarantees in contracts; this is a high-risk delivery obligation.
findings.quote: Acceptance criteria: offline ranking uplift (NDCG@10) of at least 10% over TravelHub's current rule-based sort; p95 API latency under 250 ms.

findings.title: Invoices to be raised by AtliQ Pvt Ltd
findings.why: The contract is with AtliQ Inc, but invoicing is specified via an Indian entity, creating tax and contracting mismatch.
findings.comparison: Contract is for AtliQ Inc under UAE law, but lists an Indian entity for invoicing.
findings.quote: Invoices under this Agreement shall be raised by AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3

findings.title: Specific IP assignment of AI models
findings.why: AtliQ might lose reusable AI assets if trained models and weights are fully assigned to the client.
findings.comparison: Client typically owns deliverables on payment, but specific AI models/weights may be pre-existing or reusable tools.
findings.quote: including the trained models and model weights for the Itinerary Personalization Engine and Partner Hotel Ranking Module.

findings.title: Compliance with Saudi law
findings.why: AtliQ must ensure it has the operational capability to comply with Saudi data laws, which may impose specific data residency or processing requirements.
findings.comparison: Not standard in AtliQ's typical US/India contracts.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall process personal data only on TravelHub's documented instructions and in compliance with Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data and, where applicable, the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law.

findings.title: Data location restriction
findings.why: This restricts AtliQ's ability to use its own development environments or tools if they involve data transfer, potentially hindering service delivery.
findings.comparison: More restrictive than standard AtliQ contracts.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall not transfer Customer Data outside the TravelHub cloud environment without prior written approval.
